note: Service Desk stage 1, 1d-B: the parts data service WITHOUT stock movements and its two routes, closed to users until 1.3b (PARTS_API_OPEN). The data service itself is proven by the PG17 lab .sdparts/battery.ts (service-desk-parts-lab.yml).

lib/services/service-desk/parts-lock.tes.reason: pure (no DB): owner rule 2026-11-10 — the parts API stays closed until the intake and signature path (1.3b): PARTS_API_OPEN is false, every handler of the two routes calls assertPartsApiOpen() first, the closed answer is ACTION_NOT_IN_SCOPE, only those routes import the service; exactly RESERVE / RELEASE / SET_PRICE / CANCEL in scope and every other part action refused with a reason; the service never calls the inventory writer, never writes an inventory table, never links a stock movement; run by service-desk-ci.yml and security-gate (pure lab)

lib/services/service-desk/parts-http-har.reason: pure (no DB): #1116 hardening (owner 2026-11-16) — every handler of the five parts / external-work routes runs in serviceDeskRoute, asserts its API gate first, is rate-limited (SERVICE_DESK_PARTS_WRITE fail-closed / _READ fail-open, keyed by session user AND business) before reading the request, reads the body with the 16 KiB byte cap (413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, chunked and lying Content-Length included), takes the business and actor from the session only, and the services never take the business from their input; run by service-desk-ci.yml and security-gate (pure lab)
